description: Convert a specified amount using ECB reference rates via Frankfurter. Requires finite amount > 0 and <= 1000000000, from_currency and to_currency (supported three-letter ISO codes). Returns amount, converted_amount, rate and published rate date. One CelerAPI call; get_fx_rate is not a prerequisite. Informational estimate, not trade execution or a real-time quote. Price: $0.0011 production USDC via x402 on Base mainnet. Example arguments: {"amount":500,"from_currency":"GBP","to_currency":"USD"}.
name: convert_currency
